name: BÀI VIẾT CHƯƠNG 1 · BẢN THÂN, NHÀ MÌNH VÀ BẠN BÈ
de: Con viết 2–3 câu tự giới thiệu nhé: chào, tên con là gì, rồi chào tạm biệt.
mauCau: Can you tell me about yourself? - I'm in Class 5C. I live in the countryside.
What's your favourite animal? - It's a dolphin.
Do you live in this building? - Yes, I do.
What's your address? - It's 45 Ba Trieu Street.
What nationality is he/she? - He's/She's Australian.
What's he/she like? - He's/She's friendly.
What do you like doing in your free time? - I like playing the violin.
What do you do at the weekend? - I usually listen to music.
What would you like to be in the future? - I'd like to be a doctor.
Why would you like to be a doctor? - Because I'd like to help people.

goiY.nhan: Mở đầu — chào và nói con là ai
Nói nghề mình muốn làm sau này

I'd like to be a gardener.
I'd like to be a reporter.

goiY.nhan: Nói LÍ DO mình muốn làm nghề ấy

goiY.nhan: Nói mình HAY làm việc gì, mấy lần

goiY.nhan: Hỏi xem ai đó có sống ở chỗ này không

It's one hundred and sixteen Tran Hung Dao Street.

de: Con viết 2–3 câu về cơ thể và sở thích của con: con thích làm gì, và chỉ một bộ phận trên mặt.
mauCau: Where's the library? - It's on the second floor.
Could you tell me the way to the computer room, please? - Go upstairs. It's on the first floor.
What school activity does he/she like? - He/She likes reading books.
Why does he/she like reading books? - Because he/she thinks it's interesting.
Where are the maps? - They're beside the board.
Whose crayon is this? - It's Linh's.
Were you at the campsite yesterday? - Yes, we were. / No, we weren't.
What did you do yesterday? - We played badminton.
Did they go to Ba Na Hills? - Yes, they did. / No, they didn't.
What did they do there? - They visited the old buildings.

name: BÀI VIẾT CHƯƠNG 3 · GIA ĐÌNH, NGÀY TẾT VÀ SỨC KHOẺ
de: Con viết 2–3 câu về đồ dùng học tập của con: con có gì, màu gì.
mauCau: Did you swim? - Yes, I did. I swam with my mother.
What did your family do in Ha Long Bay? - We took a boat trip around the bay.
Will you buy a branch of peach blossoms for Tet? - Yes, I will. / No, I won't. I'll make spring rolls.
Where will you go at Tet? - I'll go to my grandparents' house in the countryside.
What will you do on Children's Day? - We'll sing, dance and have a party.
What food / drinks will you have at the party? - We'll have fruit juice and milk tea.
How does he stay healthy? - He does morning exercise every day.
How often does he swim? - Every day. Even at the weekend.
What's the matter? - I have a headache.
You should go to the dentist. Go as soon as possible. - OK, I will. Thanks for your advice.

goiY.nhan: Nói món ăn, đồ uống sẽ có trong tiệc

name: BÀI VIẾT CHƯƠNG 4 · THỜI TIẾT, TRUYỆN KỂ VÀ NHỮNG NƠI ĐÁNG ĐẾN
de: Con viết 2–3 câu về nhà con: trong phòng có gì, và một người trong nhà làm nghề gì.
mauCau: How's the weather in Ha Noi in summer? - It's hot.
What do you usually wear in winter? - I wear a jumper.
Who are the main characters in the story? - They're Snow White and seven dwarfs.
How did she cook? - She cooked very well.
Where do you want to visit? - I want to visit Hoan Kiem Lake.
How can I get to Hoan Kiem Lake? - You can get there by bus.
What do you think of Ban Gioc Waterfall? - I think it's beautiful.
How far is it from our school to Ho Guom Walking Streets? - It's about two kilometres.
Where are you going to visit this summer? - I'm going to visit My Khe Beach in Da Nang City.
What are you going to do this summer? - I'm going to join a music club.
